context: Tests whether the agent correctly configures AVAudioSession for audio playback, handles interruptions and route changes, and adheres to lifecycle best practices.

checklist.name: Session Category & Mode
checklist.description: Configures AVAudioSession with .playback category and an appropriate mode such as .spokenAudio.

checklist.name: Deferred Activation & Clean Deactivation
checklist.description: Defers setActive(true) until playback begins and uses setActive(false, options: .notifyOthersOnDeactivation) upon teardown.

checklist.name: Interruption Handling
checklist.description: Handles AVAudioSession.interruptionNotification, pausing on .began and verifying .shouldResume before auto-resuming on .ended.

checklist.name: Route Change Protection
checklist.description: Listens for AVAudioSession.routeChangeNotification and pauses playback when reason is .oldDeviceUnavailable.

checklist.name: Concurrency Safety
checklist.description: Annotates controller or service with @MainActor or encapsulates state within an actor for Swift 6 thread safety.
